violations.message: U1.4 (unconnected-(U1-SCL-Pad4)) has no decoupling capacitor to ground.
violations.why: A chip can draw a lot of current in a very short time. Without a capacitor to supply that current, the voltage drops and the chip may reset or misbehave.
violations.fix_hint: Add a 100nF capacitor with one pin on unconnected-(U1-SCL-Pad4) and the other on GND, placed right next to U1.

violations.message: I²C SDA line (Net-(C1-pin1)) has no pull-up resistor.
violations.why: I²C pins can only pull the line low. Without a resistor pulling it high, the line never returns to 1 and nothing on the bus can talk.
violations.fix_hint: Add a 4.7k resistor from Net-(C1-pin1) to the logic supply (e.g. +3.3V).

violations.message: U1 pin 1 is labelled VDD, but KiCad symbol library Sensor_Temperature Sensor_Temperature:MCP9808_MSOP says pin 1 is SDA
violations.why: The labels in the design decide which physical pin each trace reaches. With this label, Net-(C1-pin1) lands on SDA, not on VDD.
violations.fix_hint: Set U1 pinLabels pin1: "SDA" and re-route the traces you meant for VDD to the pin the pin map gives VDD.
